Nine complete guarded commands recur all eleven regex and eight statement contracts under three seeds:207 original returned/constructor/argument identities and scalar origins,135 authored statement frames and all five unchanged default callback effects. Three complete Toolbox channels equal the exact prior committed proof byte-for-byte. Fourteen unchanged direct suites pass803 ordered groups; three foreign-source probes retain events with zero invented origins. Normalized split metadata and the actual equal-valued returned-array copy distinguisher recur unchanged. Twenty-four reason-specific evidence controls observe RED. Complete58-input book renders ten original examples/three chapters with fourteen rejection controls. All38 prior claim input hashes verify before historical mode/revision-only freeze.

Gitlinks/nonregular metadata excluded without payload reads. Host OS/Perl/Python/prove/mdBook are necessary read-only tools; project data stays on repository volume. Final book inputs/render are separately retained; rendered examples are not native execution. Exact staged canonical CI receipt is separately mandatory before pipeline parent closure; this record publishes no new canonical CI measurement. Remaining Flow/legacy/staged producers, source membership/comments/replacement, arbitrary host syntax or malicious callbacks, backend/native admission and global historical audit remain separate. No production/spec/standard-test/CI/hook/storage/dependency or other-repository changes.
